comment: MA-8-14: a terrain from a scan. Read by changesets-logic.test.mjs (the bridge validates `good` and refuses each of `refusals` in the exact words: `place` patches the element's place, null deletes a key; `el` patches the element) and by tools/promote-check Ma8Terrain.cs (TerrainPlanner's body for `plan` equals `good`, and its holds). `ground_answer` is the shape of GET /changesets/:key/:id/scan?ground=1 (review round 2): changesets-store.test.mjs (k) checks scanOverlay answers exactly these keys and types, and Ma8Terrain reads it into GroundDto. example.test names only; the points are made up.

good.name: Terrain · L00 · from Survey job-0003 · GR-FFL

elements.reason: 6 ground points, lowest per 500 mm cell, between -5000 and 1500 mm (5 m under to 1.5 m over L00's floor; ground outside that band is not read), outside the storey's walls, from job-0003; the hole is the box of all the storey's scanned walls plus 1 m (typed or not; a notch or courtyard inside it gets no ground); Sentinel adds points along the outer edge and the hole's edge, each at the nearest ground point's height — check it against the site survey

refusals.name: a place key a terrain does not take
refusals.message: a terrain takes no place.Location — it is its Points around the storey's Boundary, of the office's Toposolid type

refusals.name: no level
refusals.message: a terrain needs place.LevelName — the level the Toposolid is created on; Sentinel never picks its level

refusals.name: no type
refusals.message: a terrain needs place.TypeName — the office's Toposolid type (the guideline's Toposolid rule); Sentinel never takes the model's first type

refusals.name: two points make no surface
refusals.message: a terrain needs place.Points, 3 to 2000 finite [x,y,z] points

refusals.name: points on one line
refusals.message: place.Points lie on one line in plan — Revit cannot make a surface of them; send points that are not in a line

refusals.name: two points within 1 mm in plan
refusals.message: place.Points[0] and [1] lie within 1 mm of each other in plan — Revit merges them; send one

refusals.name: a point inside the footprint
refusals.message: place.Points[6] lies inside the Boundary — ground is outside the storey's footprint

refusals.name: points spread over more than 500 m
refusals.message: place.Points and place.Boundary span 602 m in plan — a terrain is at most 500 m across

refusals.name: review round 3: points clustered 300 km from the Boundary (Revit's outer loop runs round both)
refusals.message: place.Points and place.Boundary span 300006 m in plan — a terrain is at most 500 m across

refusals.name: a point that is not a number
refusals.message: a terrain needs place.Points, 3 to 2000 finite [x,y,z] points

refusals.name: no footprint
refusals.message: terrain place.Boundary must be 3 to 256 finite [x,y] points (the storey's footprint, the hole in the Toposolid)

refusals.name: no scan behind it
refusals.message: a terrain needs from_scan {changeset} — the survey changeset whose scan its ground points came from
